english.note: Use this when the impressionistic approach specifically relies on intuition or a subjective feel rather than remembered impressions.

examples.english: I chose this colour impressionistically, without thinking it through.
examples.traditional: 我揀呢隻色純粹憑感覺，冇諗過咁多。
